status: validated implementation; full audit acceptance remains open
contract: Reserve complete mandatory output before optional dictionary workspace.
Only immutable packed UTF-8 dictionary values are reused; nested/mutable/binary shapes stay on ordinary access.
Use selected row count to require at least two potential uses per dictionary entry; decode values lazily.
Charge both per-column directory and per-dictionary references before allocation, within parent-stage and pool limits. Insufficient space declines without eviction.
Workspace ends with materialization; output retains its original conservative payload admission.

validation.releaseGates: build, types, package consumer, lint, compatibility, large files, changeset, fixtures passed

queryComparison.method: Two comparisons of six independent DuckDB-generated Parquet cases, alternating fresh processes, one warmup/four measured pairs. Every row checked; every result releases to zero.
queryComparison.interpretation: Strong repeated low-cardinality/large-batch benefit; other cases vary. No universal speedup or cloud-throughput claim.
queryComparison.fixtureDevelopment: Initial hyparquet-writer experiment produced an unsupported page on the baseline; comparisons use independently generated DuckDB fixtures instead.

runtimeBoundary: Sparse GC-dependent managed-heap samples include baseline, all rounds, retained output, release and eviction. They are lower bounds, not exact peaks or statistical comparisons. Counters are not summed; runtime flags do not cap total process or production Cloudflare memory.
remaining: Full audit and whole-runtime cap acceptance remain open.
Reuse prediction is based on shape/cardinality and selected count; future observed-reuse policy and nested dictionary reuse remain opportunities.
